# The wall sound of X Chara's double: where it comes from

The sound of the one thrown going into the wall (2.125.1, `src/main/resources/assets/celestialfall/sounds/xchara_clone_wall.ogg`)
is laid together from these recordings by `tools/xchara/make_clone_wall.py` (stretches of them, mono, faded at the
cuts, each at its level; nothing synthesized). Every one is dedicated to the public domain under **CC0 1.0 Universal**
(https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): no attribution is required; it is given here anyway. The
recordings themselves are not in the repository (the tool reads them as downloaded: `bsb_<number>.flac`).

| recording | by | page | used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Door Slamming #4 | Joseph SARDIN, BigSoundBank.com | https://bigsoundbank.com/door-slamming-4-s1501.html | the slam (0.171–0.771 s) |
| Explosion #2 | Joseph SARDIN, BigSoundBank.com | https://bigsoundbank.com/explosion-2-s1808.html | the low end under it (0–0.09 s) |
| Fall of Stone | Joseph SARDIN, BigSoundBank.com | https://bigsoundbank.com/fall-of-stone-s1022.html | the rock: stones struck on stone (1.718, 13.243 and 14.963 s), and two single stones after (4.636 and 3.096 s) |
| Wheelbarrow of limestone, reversed | Joseph SARDIN, BigSoundBank.com | https://bigsoundbank.com/wheelbarrow-of-limestone-reversed-s1634.html | the rubble (6.06–7.01 s, dying away) |

BigSoundBank (https://bigsoundbank.com/licenses.html): "Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal ... Public Domain
Dedication"; each sound page: "CC0 (public domain): Free and royalty-free".

The double's other two sounds (`xchara_clone`, `xchara_clone_throw`) are the user's own recording with its music taken
down (`tools/xchara/extract_clone.py`).
